dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior, partially obscured at the distal end by water turbulence.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and symmetrical with no visible bulges or indentations along the visible edges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-intensity grey shading along the lateral flanks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, elongated, vertical linear mark of high contrast relative to the surrounding skin along the central dorsal axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A longitudinal ridge or indentation associated with the central axial line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single, prominent longitudinal linear scar or ridge running centrally along the visible dorsal plane.
